data.additional_information:
Web Development Intern (Angular, Node.js & Database Development)

Location: Hyderabad, India (Onsite/Hybrid)

Duration: 6 Months (with possible extension based on performance)

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic Web Development Intern to join our engineering team. The selected candidate will gain hands-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining enterprise web applications. The intern will work closely with experienced developers and contribute to real-world projects involving modern frontend technologies, backend services, and database solutions.
This internship offers an excellent opportunity to learn full-stack web development and build practical industry experience using Angular, Node.js, REST APIs, and database technologies.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and enhance user interfaces using AngularJS/Angular.
• Build and maintain backend services using Node.js and Express.js.
• Design, develop, and optimize database schemas, queries, and stored procedures.
• Create and integrate RESTful APIs.
• Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and bugs.

What You Will Gain:
• Hands-on experience in full-stack web application development.
• Exposure to enterprise software development practices.
• Opportunity to work on live business applications.
• Mentorship from experienced software engineers.
• Experience working in Agile development teams.
• Opportunity to build technical and professional skills for future careers.
